comparison.objective: Prune a dead rose stem above a living bud and bin the thorny cutting; candidate services a linear-bearing block.
comparison.physical_skill: Record identifies, holds and cuts a stem while controlling the offcut. Candidate performs flush rail–jig mating and precision sliding with free-ball containment.
comparison.success_condition: Record checks cut position, preservation of the bud/healthy growth and nondropped disposal. Candidate checks complete transfer, all balls retained and no jam, separation, contamination or damage.
comparison.reason: Controlled pruning and offcut recovery do not exercise a continuous mechanical support transfer.
